articles.summary: Maris-Tech Announces Financial Results for the Six Months Ended June 30, 2026 Rehovot, Israel, Sept. 02, 2026 — Maris-Tech Ltd. (Nasdaq: MTEK, MTEKW) (“Maris-Tech” or the “Company”), a global provider of video and artificial intelligence (“AI”)-based edge computing technology, today announced its financial results for the six months ended June 30, 2026.
